create_lasr_tokenizer: create a LasrTokenizer instance with custom vocab, special tokens, and extra IDs for CTC decoding
create_lasr_encoder_config: create a LasrEncoderConfig with custom hidden size, layers, convolution kernel size, and residual weights
create_lasr_ctc_config: create a LasrCTCConfig with custom vocab size, loss reduction, and zero infinity settings for CTC training
create_lasr_encoder: create a LasrEncoder model with subsampling, rotary embeddings, and conformer blocks for audio feature processing
create_lasr_for_ctc: create a LasrForCTC model for automatic speech recognition with CTC loss and generate transcriptions
